# U9: Follow goals you don’t own: watch a tree or a level

- **Belongs to:** the Watching module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `WATCHING`, `HIERARCHY`, `OWNER-ONLY`, `LEVELS`, `PROFILES`, `ONE-WATCHING`
- **Budget:** at most 7 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Oskar, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U9

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Oskar, an engineer, watches three goals and owns none.
- Open a fresh browser as Oskar (`oskar`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Nothing is asked of you today.” is shown (else: someone who owns no goal is told so, calmly).
- **Check:** “Goals you watch” is shown (else: home shows what Oskar watches).
- _Note:_ One watching block on Home (one Watching): no second summary of the same goals.
- **Check:** (`parity`) the dash watch (`.dash-watch`) is not there and there are 1 of the home watch (`.home-watch`) (else: Home shows the goals you watch more than once).
- _Note:_ Oskar's team (Developer Experience) comes before what he watches (Home rule 4, HM3), so the rows are a scroll away on a phone.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the trow in the tree (`.tree .trow`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `(await p.locator('.tree .trow').count()) > 0 && (await p.locator('.tree .trow .trow-why').first().innerText()).length > 10`. Else it says: watched goals are not shown with what changed or how fresh they are.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Watch a whole tree from a goal page.
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Watch opens a sheet that says what watching does; with feeders, this goal or it and everything feeding it (GT3), one step more than before: seven in all.
- **Step.** Press the “Watch” button in the goal’s summary bar.
- **Step.** Press the “It and the N goals feeding it” choice in the “Watch” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Watch” button in the “Watch” dialog.
- **Check:** “Watching all” is shown.
- _Note:_ And a whole level from Watching.
- **Step.** Open Goals from the menu, then its Watching tab; the address gets `scope=watching`.
- **Step.** Press the “Change” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Watch SVP” button.
- **Check:** “Every SVP goal” is shown.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.watches.some((w) => w.personId === 'oskar' && w.kind === 'tree' && w.ref === 'ns-lead') && s.watches.some((w) => w.personId === 'oskar' && w.kind === 'level' && w.ref === 'svp')`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the watches are not saved.
- _Note:_ A watcher can follow a goal but not post its check-in or edit it.
- Go to `/check-in/lead-review` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Only Tariq Haddad checks in on this goal” is shown.
- **Check:** It fails if a non-owner was offered Post check-in.
- Go to `/goals/lead-review/edit` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Only its owner can change this goal” is shown.
- Close this browser.
